QuestInfo.name: [Fox Valley] Ranger Recruitment Test
QuestInfo.0: Now that #b#p3002020##k is finally awake, you can ask about the Fox Point Rangers.
QuestInfo.1: Maru is insisting you take some kind of Ranger recruitment test. That little kid could really use the help, so you should probably get rid of those monsters anyway.
QuestInfo.2: You pass Maru's surprise recruitment test, but it seemed a bit too easy. Aren't tests supposed to be more of a challenge than that?

default.0: I can't let just anybody be a Ranger. You've got to prove your skills first!
